name: DynamoDB
shortInfo: DynamoDB is a managed NoSQL database service provided by Amazon Web Services (AWS).
brief: Amazon DynamoDB is a managed NoSQL database service provided by Amazon Web Services (AWS) and supports key-value and document data structures and is designed to handle a wide range of applications requiring scalability and performance.
about: DynamoDB Connector enables streaming data from the DynamoDB into a user determined warehouse through DataChannel dashboard. This sync happens in an automated manner after a user has configured relevant pipelines and determined an update frequency.
availableData:
[Table/View](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/databases/dynamodb/pipelines/table-view.html)

This pipeline can be used to request and retrieve data from the database based on a table/view and/or columns chosen by the user.
